```{r}

# ==============================================================
# Forecasting pipeline: read FRED csv -> transform -> VAR rolling
# ==============================================================

# 0. librerie (installano se mancanti)
packages <- c("xts","zoo","vars","forecast","quantmod","ggplot2")
to_install <- packages[!packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"]]
if(length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, dependencies = TRUE)
library(xts); library(zoo); library(vars); library(forecast)
library(quantmod); library(ggplot2)

# 1. funzione robusta per leggere CSV di FRED (data/, colonna1=date, col2=value)
read_fred_csv <- function(filename, col_name) {
  path <- file.path("data", filename)
  if(!file.exists(path)) {
    warning("File mancante: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # supporto formati data comuni
  dates <- as.Date(df[,1], tryFormats = c("%Y-%m-%d","%d/%m/%Y","%Y/%m/%d"))
  values <- as.numeric(df[,2])
  clean <- na.omit(data.frame(Date = dates, Value = values))
  if(nrow(clean) == 0) return(NULL)
  xts_obj <- xts(clean$Value, order.by = clean$Date)
  colnames(xts_obj) <- col_name
  return(xts_obj)
}

# 2. carica le serie (sostituisci i nomi file se diversi)
UMCSENT <- read_fred_csv("UMCSENT.csv", "Sentiment")
WTISPLC  <- read_fred_csv("WTISPLC.csv", "Oil")
PI       <- read_fred_csv("PI.csv", "Income")
CPIAUCSL <- read_fred_csv("CPIAUCSL.csv", "CPI")
UNRATE   <- read_fred_csv("UNRATE.csv", "Unrate")
INDPRO   <- read_fred_csv("INDPRO.csv", "IndPro")
FEDFUNDS <- read_fred_csv("FEDFUNDS.csv", "FedFunds")

# controlla che la serie target esista
if(is.null(UMCSENT)) stop("Errore: manca UMCSENT.csv in data/")

# 3. Trasformazioni (log-diff per la maggior parte, diff per alcune serie)
#    - target: diff(log(UMCSENT)) -> d_log_Sent
#    - Oil, Income, CPI, IndPro -> diff(log)
#    - Unrate, FedFunds -> simple diff (variazione)
transform_for_model <- function(xts_obj, method = c("dlog","diff")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  if(is.null(xts_obj)) return(NULL)
  if(method == "dlog") {
    if(any(coredata(xts_obj) <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      # se valori non positivi -> log non possibile, usa diff raw come fallback
      res <- diff(xts_obj)
    } else {
      res <- diff(log(xts_obj))
    }
  } else {
    res <- diff(xts_obj)
  }
  return(res)
}

d_log_sent <- transform_for_model(UMCSENT, "dlog")
d_log_oil  <- transform_for_model(WTISPLC, "dlog")
d_log_inc  <- transform_for_model(PI, "dlog")
d_log_cpi  <- transform_for_model(CPIAUCSL, "dlog")
d_unrate   <- transform_for_model(UNRATE, "diff")
d_log_ip   <- transform_for_model(INDPRO, "dlog")
d_fed      <- transform_for_model(FEDFUNDS, "diff")

# opzionale: S&P500 (se vuoi scaricarlo; ignora se non vuoi dipendenza da internet)
d_log_sp  <- NULL
try({
  getSymbols("^GSPC", src = "yahoo", from = "1978-01-01", auto.assign = TRUE, warnings = FALSE)
  # prendiamo prezzo di chiusura (GSPC$GSPC.Close) e lo rendiamo mensile
  gspc_monthly <- to.monthly(GSPC[,6], indexAt = "firstof", OHLC = FALSE)
  d_log_sp <- diff(log(gspc_monthly))
  colnames(d_log_sp) <- "d_log_Stock"
}, silent = TRUE)

# 4. merge delle serie - intersection (date comuni)
list_series <- list(d_log_sent, d_log_oil, d_log_inc, d_log_cpi, d_unrate, d_log_ip, d_fed, d_log_sp)
# keep only non-NULL
list_series <- list_series[!sapply(list_series, is.null)]
data_merged_xts <- do.call(merge, list_series)
data_merged_xts <- na.omit(data_merged_xts)

# filtra da 1978-01-01 in poi (se già lo è non cambia nulla)
data_merged_xts <- data_merged_xts[index(data_merged_xts) >= "1978-01-01"]

if(nrow(data_merged_xts) < 36) stop("Poche osservazioni dopo le trasformazioni: controlla i CSV e le trasformazioni.")

cat("Variabili disponibili (dopo trasformazioni):", paste(colnames(data_merged_xts), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Numero osservazioni:", nrow(data_merged_xts), "\n")

# mantieni copia con date per il plotting/test
data_xts_full <- data_merged_xts

# 5. converti in oggetto 'ts' mensile per VAR (start anno, mese, freq=12)
first_date <- index(data_xts_full)[1]
start_year <- as.integer(format(first_date, "%Y"))
start_month <- as.integer(format(first_date, "%m"))
data_ts <- ts(coredata(data_xts_full), start = c(start_year, start_month), frequency = 12)
colnames(data_ts) <- colnames(data_xts_full)

# 6. train/test split (80% train)
n_total <- nrow(data_ts)
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n_total)
n_test  <- n_total - n_train
train_ts <- window(data_ts, end = c(start_year + (n_train-1 + start_month -1)/12))
test_ts  <- window(data_ts, start = time(data_ts)[n_train + 1])

cat("Osservazioni train:", n_train, " test:", n_test, "\n")

# 7. selezione lag ottimale (BIC/SC)
lag_sel <- VARselect(train_ts, lag.max = 8, type = "const")
optimal_p <- as.integer(lag_sel$selection["SC(n)"])  # BIC (SC)
if(is.na(optimal_p) || length(optimal_p)==0) optimal_p <- lag_sel$selection[1]  # fallback
cat("Lag selezionato (BIC / SC):", optimal_p, "\n")

# 8. Rolling 1-step ahead forecast con VAR (expanding window)
h_steps <- n_test
target_name <- colnames(data_ts)[1]   # assumiamo target sia la prima colonna: "d_log_Sent"
rolling_preds_var <- numeric(h_steps)
rolling_preds_naive <- numeric(h_steps)  # benchmark: persistence (last observed value)

# matrix di dati per slicing rapido
data_mat <- as.matrix(data_ts)

for(i in 1:h_steps) {
  # finestra di training espandente
  end_row <- n_train + i - 1
  train_subset <- data_mat[1:end_row, , drop = FALSE]
  # convertiamo a ts per VAR
  # calcoliamo start e fine per la sottoserie
  sub_start_time <- time(data_ts)[1]
  sub_start <- c(start_year, start_month)
  sub_ts <- ts(train_subset, start = sub_start, frequency = 12)
  colnames(sub_ts) <- colnames(data_ts)
  
  # stima VAR e previsione 1-step
  fc_val <- NA
  try({
    curr_var <- VAR(sub_ts, p = optimal_p, type = "const")
    fc <- predict(curr_var, n.ahead = 1)
    # predict returns list $fcst where each element named after variable
    fc_val <- as.numeric(fc$fcst[[target_name]][1, "fcst"])
  }, silent = TRUE)
  
  # fallback: se predict fallisce, uso ultimo valore osservato (persistenza)
  if(is.na(fc_val)) {
    fc_val <- train_subset[nrow(train_subset), which(colnames(data_mat) == target_name)]
  }
  rolling_preds_var[i] <- fc_val
  
  # naive persistence benchmark: last observed value in the expanding window
  rolling_preds_naive[i] <- train_subset[nrow(train_subset), which(colnames(data_mat) == target_name)]
}

# 9. valutazione (confronto su test set)
actual_vec <- as.numeric(test_ts[, target_name])
if(length(actual_vec) != length(rolling_preds_var)) stop("Mismatch lunghezze test / predizioni")

rmse <- function(a,b) sqrt(mean((a-b)^2))
mae  <- function(a,b) mean(abs(a-b))

rmse_var   <- rmse(actual_vec, rolling_preds_var)
mae_var    <- mae(actual_vec, rolling_preds_var)
rmse_naive <- rmse(actual_vec, rolling_preds_naive)
mae_naive  <- mae(actual_vec, rolling_preds_naive)

results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Naive Persistence","VAR (expanding rolling)"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse_naive, round(rmse_var, 6)),
  MAE   = c(round(mae_naive, 6), round(mae_var, 6))
)
print("=== Performance ===")
print(results)

# 10. grafico confronto: reale vs var forecast (date reali prese dall'xts)
test_index_dates <- index(data_xts_full)[(n_train+1):n_total]
df_plot <- data.frame(
  Date = as.Date(test_index_dates),
  Actual = actual_vec,
  VAR_Forecast = rolling_preds_var,
  Naive = rolling_preds_naive
)

library(tidyr)
df_long <- pivot_longer(df_plot, cols = c("Actual","VAR_Forecast","Naive"),
                        names_to = "Series", values_to = "Value")

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Date, y = Value, color = Series)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = paste("Forecast (target =", target_name, ")"),
       subtitle = paste("VAR lag =", optimal_p, "| obs train:", n_train, "test:", n_test),
       x = "Time", y = "Value (transformed)") +
  theme_minimal()

# 11. stampa breve sintesi
cat("\nSummary:\n")
cat("Target:", target_name, "\n")
cat("Osservazioni totali:", n_total, " train:", n_train, " test:", n_test, "\n")
cat("RMSE VAR:", round(rmse_var,6), " RMSE Naive:", round(rmse_naive,6), "\n")

```
